what_this_is: M4a (FIX-1 and FIX-2 of docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-a3-coverage-confusion-audit-v1.md; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-slurp-v2-base-program-design.md section 3 module M4a and section 4 cell B4a): cell B4a of the SLURP v2 base program on the cell B0 review-off base configs/baseline/slurp-native-dual-store-train-fold-a-review-off-v1.json. ONE ORG channel moves, in the two forms that one channel has. (1) The standing Perception fallback hypothesis general_quirky, declared exactly as item E5a expresses it in configs/baseline/slurp-native-dual-store-train-fold-a-fallback-quirky-v1.json: knowledge_stores.slot-contracts.candidate_supply.solver.fallback_candidates and its mirrored phase_material.perception.fill_params.fallback_candidates both name general_quirky, so the consumption-side candidate list gains general_quirky, labelled source=fallback with the fixed DEFAULT_FALLBACK_DISTINCTION text, only when Perception's own projected candidates omit it -- never displacing, reordering or repairing a model-proposed candidate, and never changing what the model itself is asked to produce (rails.slurp_intent_hypotheses.append_fallback_slurp_intent_hypothesis_candidates; rails.artifact_results validates the Perception-side declaration against the same legal inventory and deliberately never reads it into the response format). The third declaration surface of the same option, native_episode.role_context.params.fallback_candidates in rails.role_context, is unreachable on this base: the review-off base declares no role_context block, so the Solver's candidate rendering runs through the candidate_supply site declared here. (2) The intent-boundary knowledge store moves to knowledge/slurp/semantic/intent-boundaries-v2 (docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-semantic-store-revisions-v2-review.md, pins docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-semantic-store-release-pins-v2.json), whose five revised cards -- general_quirky, qa_factoid, qa_definition, general_greet, general_joke -- carry the one-directional qa/general contrast FIX-2 asks for. Every activation_boundary line, and therefore every retrieval key text, is byte-identical to v1, so the sealed SAEA-SLURP-INTENT-BOUNDARY-KEY-ENCODING-V1 facet vectors still bind and the Perception retrieval geometry (k=8, tau 0.0, saea-fuse-associated-values-v1, saea-rank-wcos-prior-agree-v1) is unchanged: the SELECTED facet ids stay the anchor's on every row and only the rendered values of those five cards differ. Held identical to cell B0: the roster and split, the model fragment and resident geometry, the promoted speech packets, the slot-contract store v1 with its release and snapshot hashes, the three-candidate / 28-value / 16-per-candidate candidate contract, every instruction template, the native episode role graph (Reviewer and Planner at max_iterations 0, max_revisions 0, review_loop off, two contacts per row) and the scorers. Fold B is absent. The review-off phase_tools block is carried verbatim and is inert: the review-off role graph builds no Reviewer node, so no tool action can ever be taken. It is kept because the arm speech-feature-query-native-tools declares tool_schemas and FlightRuntime.frozen_core_client_kwargs has no schema source without it, and because keeping it holds the tool block of every request identical to cell B0's. No execution plan authority, admission, scoring receipt or contact authority is created by this fragment; readiness is held and the coordinator flips it.
